title: Public Pathway Consolidation v4: complete-bound prospective experience learning
summary: PPC4 binds the complete v1-v4 normative byte stack and closes the PPC3 review: immutable acquisition/probe roles, privileged provenance noninterference, least-privilege operation targets, executable schemas, prospectively decisive pathways, conjunctive bypass gates, policy-matched substrate comparisons, matched-dose component adapters, explicit pre-confirmation DREAM schema commitments, linked mediation lineages, static-only sealing, operational side-channel tests, exact numeric rules, and status-specific evidence. Parenting remains a future acceleration/outgrowability study.
system_thesis: One recurrent base model thinks and acts through typed public operations; the same model dreams by provisionally reconciling finite causally available context; sleep alone converts publicly supported acquisition experience into durable per-life LoRA updates. PPC4 tests whether this creates prospective improvement by separately identifying record transport, decision/action policy, adaptive retrieval, recurrence, actual local-path use, continual mediation, and explicit schema formation. LoRA, text, and graph substrates receive policy-matched comparisons, and no compression or parenting claim is available without its dedicated prospective experiment.

nodes.before: Recurrent public cognition with incompletely separated component credit.
nodes.after: One charged typed public operation per call with exact state, fingerprint, debit, failure, branch, and recurrence semantics.
nodes.rationale: Thinking remains one loop, but scientific attribution requires executable public transitions.

nodes.before: Typed requested reconciliation with ambiguous identifier and trigger boundaries.
nodes.after: Same-model provisional context reconciliation, requested through opaque eligible record IDs; no automatic trigger, evidence creation, acting, or durable publication.
nodes.rationale: Dream should manage conscious context without laundering answers into sleep.

nodes.before: Support-gated runtime-row writing with a partial treatment ladder.
nodes.after: Only durable writer: canonical-root admission, local atoms, complete component matrix, exact lifecycle, cumulative clean-base LoRA publication.
nodes.rationale: The paper's hard mechanism is whether writing makes later cognition better without poisoning it.

nodes.after: A separate reader-only LoRA process returns one typed record to an unchanged base thinker in the fixed-corpus transport assay.
nodes.rationale: Otherwise READ-LoRA can alter the thinker and transport is not identified.

nodes.after: Prospective unseen-composition rung with episodic-detail and schema-utility probes.
nodes.rationale: Stream capacity alone cannot establish learned lossy compression.

nodes.after: Separately gated acceleration and outgrowability study after basic teachability is demonstrated.
nodes.rationale: Parenting is scientifically strong but would confound the first mechanism assay.

nodes.after: Immutable ACQUISITION, MEDIATION_ACQUIRE, PROBE, or STATIC_SEAL role assigned before input hash; only eligible acquisition roots can write.
nodes.rationale: Online learning requires past acquisition outcomes while confirmatory probes must remain sterile.

nodes.after: A typed provisional DREAM schema is committed before independent confirmations and becomes sleep-eligible only after prospective support.
nodes.rationale: Makes dreamed higher-order formation temporally observable rather than post-hoc.

nodes.after: Text, graph, and reader-LoRA memories feed the same exact READ bytes to one frozen DECIDE+ACT policy adapter.
nodes.rationale: Separates memory substrate from learned action policy.

edges.before: Context pressure or request could invoke reconciliation.
edges.after: Only charged typed REQUEST_DREAM over allocated visible record IDs invokes one provisional reconciliation.
edges.rationale: Makes trigger, cost, and causal prefix testable.

edges.before: Dream influenced candidate selection and working structure.
edges.after: Dream may select public roots but never supplies positive target bytes; rows regenerate from roots and exact causal prefixes.
Only a separately sealed schema rung can upgrade capacity/retention evidence to learned-compression evidence.
edges.rationale: Aligns the strongest claim with the missing intervention.

edges.after: A provisional typed commitment precedes and predicts later independent acquisition observations.
edges.rationale: Identifies the direction from dreamed theory to future evidence.

edges.after: Only closed ACQUISITION and MEDIATION_ACQUIRE roots can enter writer eligibility.
edges.rationale: Prevents probe outcomes from becoming training data.

loops.after: Exact charged state machine with one op per call, prediction before ACT, opaque IDs, deterministic backtrack/repeat rules, no invisible retries, and explicit OPEN_LOOP removal.
loops.trigger: One current-item public state is available and call budget remains.
loops.stop_condition: STOP, DEFER, exhausted budget, provider failure, integrity failure, or closed item.
loops.rationale: Identifies recurrent computation rather than merely adaptive retrieval.

loops.after: One charged request over opaque eligible record IDs yields at most one provisional workspace replacement; closure overflow fails without truncation.
loops.trigger: Legal REQUEST_DREAM with visible unresolved records and remaining dream allowance.
loops.stop_condition: Publication, closure overflow, parse/illegal failure, provider failure, or dream budget exhaustion.
loops.rationale: Dream becomes learned context-management behavior while remaining non-evidentiary.

loops.before: Evidence-admitted causal rows train cumulative LoRA.
loops.after: Canonical roots and local atoms generate a sealed READ/DECIDE/ACT row universe; exact component cells and baselines train from clean base and publish atomically.
loops.trigger: A predeclared developmental boundary with sealed public source history.
loops.stop_condition: Atomic cold mount, no eligible rows, failed sleep preserving prior adapter, or integrity failure.
loops.rationale: Separates write quality from inference and prevents partial or unsupported learning.

loops.before: Repeated acquisition, sleep, publication, and evaluation.
loops.after: At least three successive prospectively bound cycles with separate memory, observation, path, and mount interventions; PCFL-Stream and PCFL-Schema claims remain distinct.
loops.trigger: N_ACQ new sealed independent roots are complete.
loops.stop_condition: Maximum cycles, futility, integrity failure, or prospectively defined saturation rule.
loops.rationale: The paper concerns improvement across a life, not one batch update.

claims.before: PATH improvement could support connected recurrent pathway use.
claims.after: Public pathways add value only when the actual presealed local path is traversed, PATH passes every bypass/recurrence/adaptivity gate, and bridge/binding/null interventions remove the registered gain.
claims.evidence_needed: Prospective unique-path targets, conjunctive baselines, actual trace citations, recurrence/adaptivity removal, cuts, and independent audit.

claims.after: A substrate transports supported local records only through the exact ppc4.read.v1 interface under an unchanged base thinker; policy-matched substrate value uses the same frozen DECIDE+ACT adapter.
claims.evidence_needed: Base-policy fidelity assay and matched-policy TEXT/GRAPH/LoRA behavioral comparison.

claims.after: A per-life system learns prospectively only when one immutable randomized lineage links prior memory, epistemic action, new observation, later sleep admission, later retrieved path, and later action value across at least three cycles.
claims.evidence_needed: Memory, sham-observation, path-cut, and mount interventions carried by the same mediation IDs across independent lives.

claims.after: Learned lossy schema compression requires a typed DREAM commitment before independent confirmations, later sleep eligibility, held-out fresh-composition value at fixed adapter bytes, and bounded irrelevant-detail reconstruction.
claims.evidence_needed: Prospective commitment timing, support roots, no-dream/late/shuffle/local/text/graph/off/cut controls, rank-byte surface, and numeric gates.

claims.before: Fixed-rank PCFL-Stream capacity could be called learned compression.
claims.after: PCFL-Stream supports only continual acquisition, retention, cross-era composition, capacity, and storage-efficiency claims.
claims.evidence_needed: PPC4's explicit prospective PCFL-Schema chain is required for compression language.

claims.before: Parenting could enter the first mechanism run.
claims.after: Parenting remains a future acceleration and outgrowability experiment after unparented teachability is established.
claims.evidence_needed: Separate directive, task-information audit, wrong-parent control, learning-curve acceleration, generation transfer, review, and ratification.

acceptance_tests.setup: Recompute every v1-v4 change/protocol hash and precedence edge and mutate one inherited byte at a time.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the exact complete ordered stack validates; conflict resolution is deterministic and no unlisted artifact becomes normative.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Exact interpretation or ratification of the composite architecture.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise all item roles, attempted role transitions, acquisition/probe close, mixed ancestors, later visibility, and writer admission.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only closed ACQUISITION or MEDIATION_ACQUIRE roots write; PROBE bytes remain sterile forever.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The online-learning versus confirmatory-evaluation boundary.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate every formal visibility class, hidden generator labels with partition fixed, partitions with public bytes fixed, opaque IDs, operational channels, and cross-item results.
acceptance_tests.expected: Forbidden changes are byte- and selection-inert; SLEEP uses only opaque partition equality/union; permitted same-item/acquisition changes remain local.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Complete least-privilege visibility, provenance use, or selection noninterference.

acceptance_tests.setup: Validate every request/response field, extra/missing arguments, typed operation admission, causal prefix, repeat/error rendering, debit, branch transition, valid diamonds, and directed cycles.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exactly one parser/state result exists; free-form semantic targets fail admission; diamonds pass and cycles fail.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Executable public cognition and operation-target safety.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inject shortcuts/answers/dream prose and construct unique presealed paths with authentic traces, bridge/binding/null cuts, alternative-path searches, and actual citation checks.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only local atoms and typed operation targets survive; the authentic trace uses the presealed path and every intervention has its registered structural effect.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Constructibility of actual local-path use rather than shortcut memorization.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run TEXT, GRAPH, and isolated LoRA readers through ppc4.read.v1 under base and identical frozen policy-adapter processes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Request/response/token/candidate bytes match exactly; provider identity is absent; reader LoRA never mounts in THINK/ACT.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Reader transport or policy-matched substrate identification.

acceptance_tests.setup: Build three D-token component adapters, all additive 2x2x2 mounts with zero slices, and joint/bundled 3D adapters from one eligible manifest.
acceptance_tests.expected: Positive exposures, optimizer schedules, rank slices, source allocations, active shapes/bytes, and claim namespaces match exactly.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Matched-dose component effects or separation from the joint PATH package.

acceptance_tests.setup: Serialize every bypass and substrate baseline, primary active-byte caps, inference budgets, deterministic truncation, and secondary full-cost ledger.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every C4 comparator has an exact interface and conjunctive promotion gate; no favorable resource view can be selected after results.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Baseline completeness, fairness, or LoRA-specific promotion.

acceptance_tests.setup: Script fixtures solvable only by adaptive query, only by recurrent post-return thought, or by neither; execute PATH, ONE_SHOT_QUERY, and OPEN_LOOP.
acceptance_tests.expected: Each contract removes only its named mechanism and scripted metrics move as predicted.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Constructibility/sensitivity of the two distinct contrasts, not their real effect.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run canonical shuffle, twin, bridge/binding/null cut, near-duplicate, split, and independent graph-oracle fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Registered marginals remain fixed, decisive bindings are destroyed, no replacement path survives, and source/target families remain disjoint.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Authenticity of pathway interventions and target construction.

acceptance_tests.setup: Two no-import implementations freeze only counts, hashes, bytes, roles, partitions, splits, twins, cuts, shuffles, candidate domains, static classifiers, and scripted closures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Independent outputs agree exactly; no model or behavioral ceiling is invoked.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Static instrument independence and no-model sealing authority.

acceptance_tests.setup: Simulate four cycles and carry immutable randomized mediation IDs through memory, epistemic action, observation, writer row, adapter, later path, and probe action under four interventions.
acceptance_tests.expected: No unlinked stage averages can join; sham rows match exposure; every missing/failure state follows one lineage.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Constructibility of complete experiential mediation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate schema commitments before/after confirmations, independent/repeated roots, contradictions, hidden target combinations, and all no-dream/late/shuffle/local controls.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only pre-confirmation commitments with two independent later supports and zero contradictions become sleep-eligible; target bytes remain inert.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Prospective DREAM schema formation and support.

acceptance_tests.setup: Freeze Stream/Schema generators, fresh-symbol compositions, detail probes, rank/byte grid, cohorts, panels, and literal claim map.

acceptance_tests.setup: Pair cache, latency, batching, provider/error timing, filesystem/process perturbations and inject condition-specific failures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Model/selection bytes remain invariant; fixed logical budgets hold; differential missingness is detected and invalidates comparison at the registered threshold.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Resistance to indirect operational-condition leakage.

acceptance_tests.setup: Recompute Holm familywise control, simultaneous intervals, 0.35 effect threshold, 0.80 power simulation, slope rules, equivalence margin, life count, and maximum extension from untouched pilot variance.

acceptance_tests.setup: Execute PATH, adaptive-query/open-loop removals, every C4 bypass, actual trace checks, and bridge/binding/null/shuffle interventions.

acceptance_tests.falsifies: Recurrent connected-pathway causality.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fresh review recomputes all actual bytes, roles, roots, rows, mounts, treatments, baselines, resources, paths, schema, mediation, statistics, lifecycle, missingness, and reporting states.

human_boundary.decision_question: After fresh PPC4 interpretation, cross-critique, and consensus, do you ratify the exact complete-bound PPC4 architecture and proposal-only scope, authorizing isolated contracts, deterministic CPU/no-model fixtures, and exactly two independent static no-model sealers while keeping parenting and every model/GPU action behind a later exact run decision?
forbidden_before_approval: Any implementation or sealer execution before exact PPC4 architecture ratification
Any model call, canary, adapter training, behavioral treatment, or GPU use before a later exact run-manifest ratification
Any parenting implementation or experiment in the PPC4 mechanism scope
Any claim beyond the exact executed intervention and passing independent audit
